protocol.population: All 551 already examined primary ex+1 events in 2023-01-03..2026-10-13, including 325 SSR-active at the open. No forecast-profit filter, full-opening-depth admission, 3% opening anchor or three-name cap.
protocol.flow: At most 5% of observed one-second volume across distinct XNAS/ARCX/EDGX and listing feeds. Exclude the first 60 seconds, including opening auction prints. Partial entries are kept; unfilled quantities canceled at the window end. Not consolidated US volume.
protocol.ssr: Dynamic cached status; unknown restriction treated as restricted, known nontrading states excluded. Peg offer one tick above the latest sampled best bid at the start of the bar. Uniform bar-price distribution approximates volume at/above that offer; capture 25/50/75% of the 5% eligible-volume allocation. Quotes are sampled direct feeds, not verified live NBBO; queue position and compliant broker execution unverified.
protocol.target: Conditional target-fill sensitivity: equal-dollar one-minute slices through the entry window; restricted slices fill 25/50/75%, unrestricted slices 100%, if a valid quote exists. Assumes sufficient flow; required entry participation reported. No evidence that these targets actually fill.
protocol.prices: Entry uses contemporaneous sampled bid (unrestricted) or bid-plus-tick (restricted), with adverse bar-range midpoint adjustment for unrestricted flow. Extra impact 25/10/5 bps per side. Entry amount capped at target in dollars before fees. No legacy 3.11% proxy or duplicated spread/depth addition.
protocol.cover: From 90 minutes before close to 15 minutes before close, buy at sampled ask, taking at most 5% of observed volume. Residual assumes completion at the final observed ask plus 5/2/1% surcharge. All residual completions flagged and retained in P&L, with +20%/+100% gap loss sensitivity. This is conditional same-day completion, not proof of flatness.
protocol.fees: IBKR Pro Fixed 0.005/share, $1 minimum, 1% notional cap per occupied five-minute child bucket per side; current SEC 20.60/million sold, normal TAF .000195/share capped9.79 per sell child, CAT .000003/share both sides, cents rounded up. Cover residual is a separate child. Replacements within a five-minute child assumed not to restart its minimum.
protocol.financing: Conditional same-day flat: zero borrow/proceeds credit. A failed cover instead retains a short liability, adds gap/borrow exposure, and invalidates the same-day business-income estimate. Borrow approval and locate fees unverified.
protocol.risk: Daily closing-equity dollar drawdown; not intraday maximum loss. Full-session quote marks estimate peak exposure/margin at 100% house, Reg-T low-price floors and 102%-rounded borrow collateral. $10m hypothetical NAV only for ratios. No account-level cap enforced; aggregate concurrency and +200% squeeze loss shown.
protocol.validation: Retrospective assumption sensitivity, all 48 variants retained, no new untouched holdout claim. Designated execution holdout file remains unread. No production strategy change, broker orders or paid downloads.

participation_protocol.rule: Reuse H21 flow replay, all two targets/four windows/three combined cases. Both entry and cover participation increase to the specified rate of recorded venue flow. SSR capture unchanged. Extra impact per side equals H21 case impact times sqrt(rate/0.05); this scaling is an uncalibrated sensitivity, not an empirical impact estimate. No other admission or exit change.
participation_protocol.validation: Declared after seeing all H21 results and before any H22 replay. Retrospective capacity/cost sensitivity, all 48 extra variants retained. No winning rate promoted and no additional data or trading authority.

chart_frequency: month-end; risk metrics use every session
